title: Introduction and overview — Shelby Cobra (1962-1967)
description: Introduction and overview of the Shelby Cobra (1962-1967): What this car is, its place in automotive history, and why collectors care. The Shelby Cobra stuffed a Ford V8 into the lightweight British AC Ace roadster, creating America's definitive sports car. The 427 Cobra made 425 hp and hit 60 mph in about 4.2 seconds in 1965.
